story: The Book Barn was built in 1822 and is a five-story building which exudes bookish charm with its cozy nooks, stone walls, friendly atmosphere, wood-burning stove, and shelf upon shelf of books, maps, and prints. Baldwin’s Book Barn is an inveterate and unique institution of Chester County, Pennsylvania where people have come for decades to buy and sell books. Discover what’s new at Baldwin’s Book Barn. From updates, special collections, and exclusive recommendations, we’ve got you covered. Baldwin’s Book Barn: A Literary Legacy Thomas Baldwin, the longtime proprietor of Baldwin’s Book Barn in West Chester, Pennsylvania, was a guardian of literary tradition.
